lines.speaker: Elder Maren
lines.text: Another wanderer on the border road. You picked a poor season for it.

lines.speaker: Elder Maren
lines.text: Folk have been going missing on the graveyard path. Not dead, mind. Gone. Their own kin can't recall their faces.

lines.speaker: Elder Maren
lines.text: Will you walk out past the fence and see what stirs among the stones?

lines.speaker: Elder Maren
lines.text: Then take these. My father swore by them. [Received 2 Minor Potions.]

lines.speaker: Elder Maren
lines.text: Rest at the well when the road wears on you. The water still remembers being holy.

lines.speaker: Elder Maren
lines.text: Hm. Most say that. Most are gone by spring.

lines.speaker: Elder Maren
lines.text: Change your mind and you know where I stand. The well in the square will rest you either way.
